notes: Registered in docs/research/score-components-v1.md and bound by entry-signal-family-rules-v1.md. minimum_completed_trades counts EPISODES, one per pump event, not decision rows. The margins are read as ABSOLUTE spreads between the top and bottom quintile: a component that predicts the outcome downwards is as informative as one predicting it upwards, which is the point given the composite already ranks backwards. A candidate also requires monotonicity across all five quintiles. Sufficiency is checked before either verdict.
